subject: Web Development
title: The Database Moves to the Browser
description: A quick, practical guide to The Database Moves to the Browser.

hook.text: What if your web app kept a full database replica right in the user's browser?

buildup.text: Tools like PouchDB and CRDT-based sync engines let apps work offline and sync later.

discovery.text: SQLite compiled to Wasm runs full SQL queries in the browser with zero network latency.

twist.text: Local-first apps feel instant because the data is already there. No loading spinners needed.

climax.text: The local-first movement is rethinking where data should live — closer to the user.

quiz.question: What does local-first architecture improve?
options: Responsiveness by keeping data in the browser
